```{r}
library(tidyverse)
mycsv <- read_csv("GIS/WK1/fly-tipping-borough-CORRECTED.csv")  
```
```{r}
spec(mycsv)
```
```{r}
summary(mycsv)
```

```{r}
library(sf)
shape <- st_read("GIS/WK1/statistical-gis-boundaries-london/statistical-gis-boundaries-london/ESRI/London_Borough_Excluding_MHW.shp")
```
```{r}
summary(shape)
```
```{r}
plot(shape)
```


```{r}
spec(mycsv)
```
```{r}
library(sf)
shape%>%
  st_geometry()%>%
  plot()
```

```{r}
shape2 <- shape%>%
  merge(.,
        mycsv,
        by.x="GSS_CODE", 
        by.y="code")
```
```{r}
shape%>%
  head(., n=10)
```
```{r}
shape%>%
  head(shape,n=10)
```
```{r}
head(shape,n=10)
```
```{r}
library(tmap)
```
```{r}
tmap_mode("plot")
# change the fill to your column name if different
shape2 %>%
  qtm(.,fill = "2011-12")
```
```{r}
shape2%>% st_write(.,
"GIS/WK1/flytipping.gpkg",
layer="london_boroughs_fly_tipping",
delete_dsn = TRUE
)
```
```{r}
library(readr)
library(RSQLite)

con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(),dbname="GIS/WK1/flytipping11-12.gpkg")
```
```{r}
con%>%
  dbListTables()
```
```{r}
con%>%
  dbWriteTable(.,
               "original_csv",
               mycsv,
               overwrite=TRUE)


con%>%
  dbDisconnect()
```

ls()
